title: Tjio and Levan reported 46 human chromosomes
summary: Their Hereditas paper is the count of 46. Crossref's online date is a later digitization.
body: Joe Hin Tjio and Albert Levan, "The Chromosome Number of Man," is the paper that established the human diploid count as 46, correcting the long-taught count of 48. The DOI 10.1111/j.1601-5223.1956.tb03010.x encodes the 1956 Hereditas publication. Crossref's issued date is 9 July 2010, which is an online republication date, not the year of the count. The v1 article's "humans have 46 chromosomes (23 pairs)" matches this result. It is a cytogenetic count, not a statement about every developmental anomaly.
